text:
Given the location of pain at the medial tibial plateau inferior to the patella and the history of repetitive pivoting in volleyball, this presentation is classic for medial patellofemoral pain syndrome or early medial meniscus irritation rather than tibial tubercle apophysitis, which typically affects the anterior tubercle. I will now proceed with the diagnosis based on the clinical picture of activity-related anterior/medial knee pain without mechanical symptoms or structural damage on X-ray.

DIAGNOSIS READY: Patellofemoral Pain Syndrome
